newsitem.title: NORWAY: Awilco trades up 4.6 pct on merger report.
newsitem.headline: Awilco trades up 4.6 pct on merger report.

text.p: Shares in Norwegian offshore services company Awilco ASA were trading 4.6 percent up in healthy volume on Thursday after a report that the company was planning to merge with Petroleum Geo-Services ASA (PGS).

At 1253 GMT, Awilco had advanced four crowns to 91.50 crowns in turnover of 54 million crowns. It was the third most traded share in turnover terms on the Oslo bourse so far in the session at 54.4 million crowns.
Earlier Thursday, financial news magazine, Kapital, said that the two companies were looking to merge operations by the end of the year.
Kapital said synergies between the two could be considerable and the new merged group would be prepared for further growth.
PGS declined to comment on the report, saying the rumours were old.
Meanwhile PGS, which is based in Houston, was trading seven crowns down at 418 crowns.
